description: PipeNetGen generates synthetic distribution networks from open or utility data using graph methods and mixed-integer optimisation. The method adds clustering, hydraulic checks and fire-flow assessment, with a Lakewood, California comparison. This resource is provided by Zauscher, Elias; Berglund, Emily. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: It is one research method and release; the comparison is a provider-reported result. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
